2018 990 Data

Source: R/data.R
dat.2018.Rd

All data used to generate model6. Contains raw 990 data, features, and factor scores.

Usage

dat.2018

Format

An object of class data.table (inherits from data.frame) with 64139 rows and 24 columns.
